Self check-in
Check yourself in with the keypad.
Whether you require accommodation for a romantic weekend, family holiday or group stay – Mani Apartments have an option for you.

We offer a home away from home, with all necessary amenities and a downtown location. 
The apartments are self-checkin but we offer 24/7 guest service through phone and email.

All of our apartments are unique and individually styled. 
Please note that this property is located downtown, on the main shopping and bar/restaurant street, which is full of life, joy and cul

The space
A commodious 4 Bedroom apartment of 110m2. The apartment can lodge up to 10 guests. The bedding is arranged with 2 single beds in the first and second bedrooms, and in the third and fourth bedrooms double or 2 single beds can be arranged + 1 single bed. The apartment has three private bathrooms with a shower. 
The kitchen is fully furnished with a dishwasher, fridge, microwave, toaster, cooking facilities and tea/coffee maker.

Guest access
Check in at your own convenience with our simple self-check-in process. Check-in details will be sent via email before arrival, and support is available 24/7 if needed.

Guests have access to the whole apartment. Everything is private and for you to use at your convenience.

Other things to note
Located in the heart of downtown, the hotel is surrounded by lively bars, restaurants, and nightly live music until 11pm from the bar in our building. There may be some nighttime noise, but it’s all part of Reykjavik’s vibrant atmosphere—perfect for those looking to join in the fun!

We have cameras monitoring the common areas of the building and front doors, for your safety

Stayed with kids
Don't rent here! 
During our July 2026 stay, multi-day construction ran on the building's exterior. A worker on a boom lift closed our window and drilled directly outside our bedroom starting at 8:35 the first morning, and the work continued for all of our four days. None of it was disclosed at booking. 
The host's explanation changed three times in writing: first unexpected maintenance, then a pipe emergency lasting under three hours, then finally a multi-day municipal facade project. 
The dishwasher was broken the entire stay. A technician came, needed parts, and never returned, so our group of seven hand-washed dishes all week. 
The front door also would not close nor lock properly our whole stay, a genuine security concern with kids in the unit. 
The initial remedy offered for all of this was a late checkout. The location is convenient, but a professional operator should disclose known disruptions and maintain basic equipment. We cannot recommend staying here.

Where you’ll be
Reykjavík, Iceland
Mani Apartments are located in the heart of Reykjavik City at Laugavegur 18. Laugavegur is the main street of the city, no car is necessary to explore the sights near the hotel. Short walk to all restaurants, bars, cafés. Please note that parking in the downtown area is not for free, and please have a look at the parking signs.

The worth visiting locations:
- Hallgrimskirkja Church: one of the tallest structures in Iceland, the magnificent 74.5m high church is located 550m from the Hotel.
- Harpa concert hall: the Crystalline façade inspired by Icelandic scenery is just 700 m away from the Hotel.
- Sun Voyager, an ode to the Sun, the sculpture designed by Jón Gunnar Árnason can be visited in 1.2 km from Máni apartments.
- The historical building, the Culture House is in 250 m distance from the Hotel.
- Reykjavik's oldest public baths in Iceland, Sundhöllin can be found 800m from the Hotel.
